answer.summary: A bounded investigation into whether agent response structure exhibits self-referential consistency across iterations under identical input conditions, independent of feature vectors or external validation, is required without speculative extrapolation.
answer.content: This task focuses exclusively on identifying explicit or implicit evidence in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 3.3 for self-referential consistency in agent responses when input conditions are held constant and no feature vectors or external memory mechanisms are present. The review must be strictly limited to observable, cited behaviors in the source text and must avoid inferring memory autonomy where no empirical indicators exist. All findings must be directly traceable to the source material to maintain research integrity and scientific rigor.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to retrieve and inspect Kumar et al., 2024, Section 3.3 for any explicit or implicit description of agent self-referential consistency in response structure across iterations under identical input conditions without feature vectors or external validation
answer.lesson: In research-only investigations, a bounded inquiry into specific, observable phenomena must be confined to direct evidence in the source text; absence of evidence for a claimed capability must be formally documented and the inquiry redirected to a testable, narrowly defined alternative without speculative extension or assumption.'
